† [בָּכַר] vb. (NH בְּכֵּר, Aramaic בַּכֵּר, ܒܰܟܰܪ; cf. Arabic بَكَرَ rise early, do anything early; بِكْرٌ, virgin, woman having her first child; Ethiopic በኵር primogenitus; Assyrian bukru, first-born, Dl§ 65, 5)—
Pi. Impf. יְבַכֵּר Ez 47:12; Inf. לְבַכֵּר Dt 21:16;— 1. bear early, new fruit Ez 47:12. 2. make or constitute as first-born Dt 21:16 (den. of בכור).
Pu. Impf. יְבֻכַּר Lv 27:26 born or made a firstling.
Hiph. Pt. f. מַבְכִּירָה Je 4:31 one bearing her first child.
